Concepts

This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-SetOperator defines the following codes in a Is-A hierarchy:

LvlCodeDisplayDefinitionNot SelectableStatus
1_ValueSetOperator ValueSetOperatorOperations that can be used to associate concepts in a terminology.trueactive
2  E excludeForm the set-difference with this value, i.e., exclude this element or set from the resulting set.active
2  I includeForm the union with this value, i.e., include this element or set in the resulting set.active
1A intersectForm the intersection with the value.active
1H convex hullForm the convex hull with the value. The convex hull is defined over ordered domains and is the smallest contiguous superset (interval) that of all the operand sets.active
1P periodic hullForm the periodic hull with the value. The periodic hull is defined over ordered domains and is the periodic set that contains all contiguous supersets of pairs of intervals generated by the operand periodic intervals.active
